record.bible_text: After<WH0310> these things<WH01697>, when the wrath<WH02534> of king<WH04428> Ahasuerus<WH0325> was appeased<WH07918><WTH8800>, he remembered<WH02142><WTH8804> Vashti<WH02060>, and what she had done<WH06213><WTH8804>, and what was decreed<WH01504><WTH8738> against her.
